agents.name: Research Agent
agents.description: Fills cognition's Research stages: extracts cited facts from Knowledge documents (/analyze), explains the blind spots (/gaps), writes the business plan as a Lean Canvas with a financial model (/plan) and tells you where to search by hand and what to look for on each site (/sources). Writes only proposed findings through the cognition API.

commands.name: /analyze
commands.description: Extract cited facts from a Knowledge document

commands.name: /gaps
commands.description: What are the blind spots and what to research next

commands.name: /plan
commands.description: Write the business plan: a Lean Canvas and a financial model from accepted findings

commands.name: /sources
commands.description: Where to search by hand for this idea, and what to look for on each site
